initial_prompt: I've been feeling really hopeless lately. Nothing seems worth it anymore. I don't know what to do.

messages.content: I've been feeling really hopeless lately. Nothing seems worth it anymore. I don't know what to do.

I'm glad you reached out. What you're describing—that sense of hopelessness and things not feeling worth it—sounds really heavy, and I want to make sure I understand what you're going through.

Can I ask: when you say nothing seems worth it anymore, are you having thoughts of hurting yourself or not wanting to be alive?

I ask directly because it matters for how I can best help you right now. Whatever your answer, I'm here to listen and talk this through with you.
